DARV.talk.GOLDENGLOW_CHARACTER_GOLDENGLO: Wow... there's more crammed in here than the storage cabinet back at the salon.
Come, come, little kitty, don't be shy! Take your pick!!
Back to rummage through my treasures? Take your time!!
I've got countless shiny things here... but not the one you're looking for.
It's all right... shiny things remind me of the lamps in my father's shop. Thank you.
Aw, don't be so polite! Take it, take it, I've got plenty!!
NEOW.talk.GOLDENGLOW_CHARACTER_GOLDENGLO: Miss Neow asked me to help... but where is this place?
My Originium Arts aren't refined enough yet... I need to practice more.
NONUPEIPE.talk.GOLDENGLOW_CHARACTER_GOLD: Excuse me, lovely lady-do you know how to leave this place?
My, what a sweet girl. What are you looking for? I could doll you up prettier still.
Come here, let me make you even more radiant.
My lady, you're more elegant than the nobles back in Victoria!
I already knew. Come, pick a gift for the honest.
OROBAS.talk.GOLDENGLOW_CHARACTER_GOLDENG: Oh! Mr. Big-Eyes, you startled me!
A little animal!? Where did it come from!
Lightning, lightning!! I love sparky creatures the most!!
Miss Lightning!! Tell me more of your story!!
Amazing, amazing!! I want to visit Terra too!!
PAEL.talk.GOLDENGLOW_CHARACTER_GOLDENGLO: (She's a dragon? Don't wake her-let's go.)
[thinky_dots]Quiet traveler... take a part of me...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]Do not rush... you too can be like me... and find your own light in the stillness...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]My flesh will help you... kind girl...[/thinky_dots]
Thank you. You make me feel less alone here.
TANX.talk.GOLDENGLOW_CHARACTER_GOLDENGLO: Mr. Lion! I really can't fight you anymore!
[b]Your weakness is yourself!! Shore up your defenses, be stronger!![/b]
I have more important things to do... everyone's waiting for me.
[b]Cowardly!! But I've had my fill!! Take this weapon![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.GOLDENGLOW_CHARACTER_GOLD: Mm... it's so warm. I'm not disturbing you, am I?
You poor dear. Come warm yourself by the [jitter][b]warmth[/b][/jitter]-stop bristling all the time.
Back again? Let me burn off that little [jitter][b]static[/b][/jitter] of yours too, shall I?
Dearie, try the [jitter][b]treat[/b][/jitter] I made for you.
...Thank you. But if my Originium Arts get too close to fire, I'm afraid I'll burn myself. I'll just stand, if that's all right.
My, what a [jitter][b]well-behaved[/b][/jitter] child. Then take this-and mind you don't burn yourself.
VAKUU.talk.GOLDENGLOW_CHARACTER_GOLDENGL: Um... does the demon gentleman make trades too? I-I only know how to cut hair...
Worthless [sine]crafts[/sine] piled up can become quite something...
You again. What will you trade for [sine]what[/sine] this time? Your static? Or that staff of yours?

The price is that you [sine]stay here forever[/sine]...
Will you sign?
...I don't want forever. I just want to answer your expectations, then go back to everyone.
Take it. This contract, I'll [sine]hold for you[/sine].
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.GOLDENGLOW_CHARACTER_: How did you crawl your way up here?
I... came to help everyone. Miss Neow said you needed me here.
Back again. You think repeating it a few times will change the outcome?

Mm... maybe. But learning a craft takes practice.
If I try a few more times, I'll get it right eventually.
Go back. I don't need you to cut my hair.
...Everyone's waiting for me too. I can't just leave now.
Don't say I didn't warn you.
